# ThinkingOrbsKit

- Commit: 44fef854b811c14b84ec670c8496436615a0c448
- Path: packages/thinking-orbs/ports/ios/ThinkingOrbsKit/Sources/ThinkingOrbsKit
- License: MIT; adjacent LICENSE is also copied into the app's Resources.

Agent Guard uses ThinkingOrb(state: .solving, size: .px64, theme: .auto, displaySize: 48).
The native port supports macOS, uses SwiftUI Canvas, and respects Reduce Motion.
No JavaScript, web view, network access or package installation is used at runtime.
